correctness.rationale: For every real input of bounded variation, the distributional-derivative decomposition reduces the norm to a single discontinuity. Explicit Chebyshev trigonometric integrals give the quadratic derivative kernel. The two-root region yields an elementary radical formula with stationary octic: exact rational Sturm counts 3 and 2 certify the unique root in (4/9,1). A rational 8001-point midpoint enclosure, proven variation-of-parameters Lipschitz extension and exact witness at c=5/6 exclude the complementary continuum. The standalone checker recreates polynomial identities, all integer square-root enclosures, bounds and separation. The step at either sign of the optimal jump gives equality. No numerical extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: Sharp total variation amplification is a natural edge-stability invariant of a canonical spectral truncation operator. The exact cubic norm and its off-center jump extremizers differ qualitatively from the same-degree Legendre case. The proof resolves a nontrivial quadratic step-response optimization over all discontinuity locations and supplies an exact rational continuum-exclusion certificate, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. No extrapolation to higher degrees is claimed.
